Subject: Request: Promo codes for Hybrid AI Symposium — Sept 21-22

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick chat earlier. TechSymposium is finalizing sponsor perks for the hybrid track (expected 2k registrants; ~500 in-person) and we'd love to provide attendees and speakers with Redwood trial credits to drive post-event trials. Can Redwood provide: 150 trial promo codes (3 months, $200 starter balance equivalent)? Proposal split: 100 attendee codes, 50 speaker codes.

Requirements from our side:
- CSV with unique codes + redemption window
- HubSpot campaign tag / tracking instructions
- A one-line blurb for sponsor page: "Redwood Inference — powering inference for production AI"

I've attached the sponsor pack and the sponsor contact for logistics. We need final code delivery no later than Aug 20 to include in the attendee email. Please let me know if a modified split is necessary.

Appreciate it —
Lena Park
Sponsorship Lead, TechSymposium
[sponsor pack attached: TechSymposium_Sponsor_Pack_v2.pdf]

Date: 2027-08-02T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Promo codes for Hybrid AI Symposium — Sept 21-22

Hi Lena — thanks, this looks good and congrats on the turnout numbers. Looping in Marissa and Monica for budget and program flow. Quick thoughts:

- I can approve a promo pool for the event but would like to adjust the split to 120 attendee / 30 speaker to preserve runway for other partner events this quarter.
- We should cap redemptions per company to avoid a single org consuming too many codes (suggest 5/account).
- We need Finance to tag these codes in HubSpot as campaign TS2027-HYBRID and set a spend tracking property.

Marissa/Monica — can you confirm the revised split and whether we can reserve an extra set for speaker honorariums? Attaching the promo_code_template.csv for tracking.

Target delivery to TechSymposium: Aug 18 (safe margin).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Partnerships & Growth Ops, Redwood Inference

+1 on approving the pool with the revised split. A couple of operational asks:

- Cap: set redemption limit to 5 codes per company and 1 code per email address to prevent mass claiming.
- Campaign naming: please use "TS2027-HYBRID" exactly (HubSpot expects exact match).
- Delivery timeline: codes need to be packaged and uploaded to their portal by Aug 18; we should be able to meet Aug 15 delivery if Finance signs off.

I'm attaching the promo_code_template.csv (sample) — use that format for the CSV with columns: code, value_usd, expires_at, campaign_tag.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
